day1_opening_2.text: *Cherry blossoms drift through the air. The breeze slips in through the sleeves of my new uniform.*

day1_opening_3.text: *My uniform is stiff and smells of starch. The creases ironed yesterday spring up whenever I bend my knees.*

day1_opening_4.text: *Just ahead stands Haedoji School, where I'll be going starting today.*

day1_opening_5.text: *The transfer was decided all of a sudden because of my parents' work. Inside my uniform pocket, the transfer papers folded in half catch against the fingertips of my left hand.*

day1_opening_6.text: *This morning, I texted Minsu: 'First day today.' Still just one gray check. The group chat from my old school is quiet too.*

day1_opening_7.text: *A cherry blossom petal brushes the tip of my nose. I turn my head before I can sneeze.*

day1_opening_8.text: *A bell rang briefly inside the school. I'd never heard it before, but my feet had already fallen into step with it.*

day1_gate_1.text: *I stand before the gates of an unfamiliar school.*

day1_gate_2.text: *The school is large and spotless. Beyond the broad field, morning sunlight lies in neat bands across the building's windows.*

day1_gate_3.text: *Keys rattle in a tracksuit pocket amid laughter and chatter. A worn sleeve brushes my new one as someone passes.*

day1_gate_4.text: *I meant to check the noticeboard beside the main gate pillar, yet my eyes turned first to the right of the main building entrance. Probably thanks to looking over the campus map in the enrollment guide yesterday.*

day1_gate_5.text: *One deep breath. I push the transfer papers deeper into my pocket and walk through the gate.*

day1_gate_cctv_1.text: *Just inside the main gate, a security camera beside the pillar catches my eye. Above the corner of the perimeter wall and the front entrance, red indicator lights blink at a steady rhythm. Must be a school that keeps a close eye on its facilities.*

day1_hallway_1.text: *Past the entrance hall, I come to a stop at the first junction.*

day1_hallway_2.text: *Even staring at the floor plan on the wall, I can't make out at a glance how the stairs to the first- and second-year classrooms connect to the annex walkway.*

day1_hallway_3.text: *For now, I head down the right-hand corridor where the classroom sign points.*

day1_sea_meet_1.text: Are you the transfer student? I heard someone was coming today.

day1_sea_meet_2.text: Yeah, I just transferred here. Which way do I go to get to our classroom?

day1_sea_meet_3.text: *Brown twin tails. Not a hair, ribbon, or name tag out of place.*

day1_sea_meet_4.text:
*The moment our eyes meet, Sea breaks into a bright smile.*

Pretty confusing in here, right? The main building's kind of sprawling, so everyone gets turned around at first.

day1_sea_meet_5.text: I'm Han Sea, our class rep. You're {name}, right?

day1_sea_meet_6.text: Uh, yeah. That's me. How do you know my name?

day1_sea_meet_7.text: Our homeroom teacher told me. She said ahead of time that we'd be getting a transfer student.

day1_sea_meet_8.text: Oh, so that's how you knew. You called my name before I even introduced myself, so it caught me off guard.

day1_sea_meet_9.text: *She must have seen the class roster or a homeroom note beforehand.*

day1_sea_meet_10.text: I was just heading to the classroom myself. Come on, I'll show you the way.

day1_sea_meet_11.text:
*Sea walks ahead, matching my pace whenever I slow down without looking back.*

This building's pretty big. I'd have been wandering around for ages on my own.

day1_sea_meet_12.text: This is the science lab. The music room is down there. The second floor is mostly for third-years, so you won't need it much.

day1_sea_meet_13.text: The school store is at the end of the first floor. The line gets long at lunch.

day1_sea_meet_14.text: Wow, you sound like you've memorized the whole place. Is that a class-rep thing?

day1_sea_meet_15.text: I am the class rep. So... I guess it is.

day1_sea_meet_16.text: *Sea slows her pace and lets out a brief laugh.*

day1_sea_meet_17.text: If the new kid gets lost, it's the class rep's job to help.

day1_sea_meet_18.text:
*Whenever we pass through the hall, other students naturally step aside for Sea.*

Just follow my back. Call out right away if you get turned around—it's faster than peeking around every corner on your own.

day1_gate_ngp_turn_back.text: *My feet stop. The moment I try to look back, my vision slowly bleeds into white. The sounds around me fade into the distance.*

day1_gate_ngp_classroom.text: *I open my eyes. A classroom. I'm sitting at my desk in the back row by the window. The date on the board is today's.*

day1_gate_ngp_teacher_2.text: *My mind is blank. I was about to do something. What was it?*

day1_choco_ngp_1.text: Oh, right—drink this. I stopped by the school store earlier and picked it up. You came empty-handed, didn't you?

day1_choco_ngp_2.text:
*Sea hands me a carton of strawberry milk. Condensation beads against my palm.*

Thanks. The carton's pretty cold.

day1_choco_ngp_3.text: *My fingers find the end of the straw wrapper without thinking. I've never held this carton before, yet even its folded corners feel familiar.*

day1_choco_1.text: *On the way to the classroom, Sea takes a small carton out of her bag.*

day1_choco_2.text: Oh, right. Want a chocolate milk? It was buy one, get one free, so I have one left.

day1_choco_3.text:
*Sea holds out a small carton of milk.*

Here, take it. Carrying the extra one around is a hassle anyway.

day1_choco_4.text:
*I take the milk carton. Condensation from the surface dampens my palm.*

Are you sure I can take this on my very first day?

day1_choco_5.text: Just showing me to the classroom was already plenty.

day1_choco_6.text: Call it a welcome gift for the transfer student. Morning classes are rough on an empty stomach.

choices: How did you know I liked this?
Actually, strawberry milk is more my thing.

day1_choco_accept_1.text: *I tap the straw taped to the side of the carton once with my fingertip, then slip it into the front pocket of my bag. I'll save it for later.*

day1_choco_accept_3.text: Chocolate is usually a safe bet.

day1_choco_accept_4.text:
*Only after watching me zip my bag shut does Sea start walking again.*

I'll drink it later during break.

day1_choco_question_1.text: Wait. How did you know I like chocolate milk?

day1_choco_question_2.text: *The corners of Sea's mouth freeze for a split second; she blinks once, and her smile returns.*

day1_choco_question_3.text: I told you, it was buy one, get one free. They had strawberry too, but chocolate seemed like the safer choice.

day1_choco_question_4.text: Oh, right. Guess I jumped to conclusions for nothing.

day1_choco_question_6.text:
*Sea laughs lightly, fiddling only with the tip of the straw taped to her own milk carton.*

It just happened to be a flavor I like, so I was glad to see it. Thanks—I'll enjoy it.

day1_choco_joke_2.text:
*Sea's step slows by half a beat.*

Oh, I didn't mean I won't drink it. I like chocolate too. Why are you looking at me like that?

day1_choco_joke_3.text: Oh, really? I'll bring strawberry next time. It was in the left slot at the snack shop.

day1_classroom_1.text: *With Sea leading the way, I reach the classroom.*

day1_classroom_2.text: *When I open the door and step inside, the chatter in the classroom dies down all at once.*

day1_classroom_3.text:
*From inside the classroom comes the scrape of a chair.*

They say that's the transfer student coming today. Where'd he move from?

day1_classroom_4.text: *Bag in hand, I stand beside the podium where Sea motioned. Beyond the windows, cherry blossom branches sway in the breeze.*

day1_classroom_5.text: *As the chatter continues, the classroom door opens and our homeroom teacher walks in.*

day1_eunsu_1.text: *A young teacher in glasses, with a gentle face.*

day1_eunsu_2.text: All right, everyone. We have a new transfer student joining us today.

day1_eunsu_4.text: {name}, could you step a little closer to the front of the board?

day1_eunsu_5.text: *At the front of the room, the smell of chalk dust is stronger. Someone shifts in their chair near the back.*

day1_eunsu_6.text: Welcome. We're glad to have you.

day1_eunsu_7.text:
*I unclench my hand.*

Thank you. I look forward to being in your class.

day1_eunsu_8.text: All right, go ahead and say hello to your classmates.

day1_eunsu_9.text: Hi, everyone. I'm {name}, and I'll be taking classes with you starting today. Nice to meet you.

day1_eunsu_10.text: Any hobbies or things you like?

day1_eunsu_11.text: Mostly I just listen to music a lot.

day1_eunsu_12.text:
*A soft laugh slips out from one of the back seats.*

Oh, I like music too.

day1_eunsu_13.text: That'll do. Everyone, make {name} feel welcome. Your seat is in the back row by the window.

day1_eunsu_14.text:
*As I walk over to the seat by the window, Sea gives me a thumbs-up and Ms. Eunsu nods.*

That went smoothly. Go on, sit down.

day1_seolhwa_1.text: *Before second period begins, I glance over my shoulder.*

day1_seolhwa_3.text: *Her dark brown hair is tousled, as if she never brushed it this morning. She stares out the window.*

day1_seolhwa_4.text: *Conversation dies out only around her desk. Chin in hand, she keeps staring outside, eyelids slightly lowered.*

day1_seolhwa_5.text: *A boy with glasses also sits alone in the far corner, reading a manga. Chairs seem to scrape more quietly in that row.*

choices: Hi, looks like I'm sitting in front of you. I'm {name}.

day1_seolhwa_greet_2.text: Hi, looks like I got the seat in front of you. I'm {name}—nice to meet you.

day1_seolhwa_greet_3.text: *She slowly lifts her head. Our eyes meet.*

day1_seolhwa_greet_4.text: *She gives a brief smile, then lowers her eyes. Her ears are red.*

day1_seolhwa_greet_5.text: *After a brief pause, she speaks in a tiny voice.*

day1_seolhwa_greet_7.text: *One word. That's all. She turns her gaze back out the window. There isn't an open textbook or even a pencil case on her desk.*

day1_seolhwa_greet_8.text: Hey, transfer kid. Who were you talking to back there?

day1_seolhwa_greet_9.text: I tried saying hi to the girl sitting behind me, and she gave me a single word before turning right away.

day1_seolhwa_greet_10.text: Oh, her? I've almost never seen her talk to anyone. She's been like that since first year.

day1_seolhwa_greet_11.text: *I look back. The girl is staring out the window. The boy with glasses in the corner hasn't looked up from his manga either.*

day1_seolhwa_greet_12.text: I see. The quiet type, huh.

day1_seolhwa_greet_13.text: She answers sometimes if you talk to her. I've never seen her speak first. I don't know her name either.

day1_seolhwa_greet_14.text: *When I face forward again, only the pale blur of morning sunlight spreads across the windowpane beside me.*

day1_seolhwa_skip.text: *I should focus on class. This isn't the time to worry about whoever's behind me.*

day1_dejavu2_1.text: *During class, I dropped my pencil and looked under the desk.*

day1_dejavu2_2.text: *There are old scratches beneath the desk, faint marks pressed into it with a pencil or compass.*

day1_dejavu2_3.text: *I can make out a few strokes of letters. A line curving left, a mark that looks like a number. When I scratch it with my nail, dust comes away.*

day1_dejavu2_4.text: *I pick up the pencil and turn back toward the board.*

day1_break_1.text: *Break time. A few boys come over.*

day1_break_2.text: Hey, transfer kid. Where'd you come from?

day1_break_3.text: A neighborhood about an hour away from here by train. I used to live near the station.

day1_break_4.text: What have you been into lately?

day1_break_5.text:
*Just as talk of my old neighborhood turns to what music everyone listens to lately, someone gets my name wrong and Sea steps in to correct them.*

Hey, if you're mixed up on his name, just ask one more time. Don't call him the wrong thing.

day1_break_6.text: Hey, Sea's really looking out for you.

day1_break_7.text: That's what she's like when class-rep mode kicks in.

day1_break_8.text: But she's never brought a lunchbox before, has she?

day1_break_9.text: Is it that unusual for Sea to bring lunch?

day1_pe_1.text: *P.E. class. Soccer. The ball went high. I trapped it with my left foot.*

day1_pe_3b.text: Just luck. It happened to land right at my feet.

day1_pe_4.text: *A camera shutter clicks from one corner of the field. A small girl holding a camera flinches.*

day1_pe_yuna_1.text: Oh, I'm so sorry! I was taking shots of the field for the photography club archives and got caught.

day1_pe_yuna_2.text: I'm Choi Yuna, a first-year. I'll sort out any shots with your face in them right away.

day1_pe_yuna_3.text: If you'd like to check them yourself, come by the library at lunch or after school!

day1_pe_wall_1.text: *I drink water on a bench after soccer. One cell of the green wire mesh atop the red brick wall is bent slightly inward. Mountains rise beyond it.*

day1_pe_wall_3.text: *The bell rang, so I headed back to the classroom.*

day1_xover_seolhwa_1.text: *As I round the corner, someone is standing in the shadows at the far end of the hall.*

day1_xover_seolhwa_4.text: *I blink once, and the end of the corridor is empty. Through the scent of cherry blossoms drifting in from the cracked window, a faint trace of antiseptic brushes past.*

day1_xover_seolhwa_5.text: *Did my eyes play tricks on me? Maybe the nurse's office is somewhere nearby.*

day1_eunsu_11_honest.text: I like gaming, and I usually listen to music a lot.

day1_eunsu_11_sea.text:
*Without thinking, I glance toward Sea first. When she lightly taps her own ear with a fingertip, the word finally comes out.*

Music.
